analytical_dimensions.description: Read the field author in context
probing_questions: Extract source-grounded claims, mechanisms, empirical design and findings, contrary cases and limits. Distinguish what the text demonstrates from what it hypothesizes; name whose claim it is. Every row must quote an actually supplied passage of this field source. Do not attribute any field fact to the focal thinker.

analytical_dimensions.description: State what this reading cannot establish
probing_questions: Identify weak evidence, untested mechanisms, conflicting interpretations and relevant questions unaddressed by these inspected ranges. A missing discussion is not a refutation.

engine_name: Read one argument in the field
problematique: Investigate the supplied question through institutional originals without requiring a target thinker. Reconstruct arguments, mechanisms, constraints, interventions and disagreement from the actual documents and voices. Keep adoption, signed views, guest contributions and participant statements distinct. Prior maps are retained analysis; only original passages support new source claims. Describe the considered, searched, acquired and actually read population separately, including geographic, language and publication-date coverage. Search misses and unavailable originals cannot establish institutional silence. Group by institution without manufacturing consensus from internal disagreement, syndicated copies or several formats of one event. Preserve evidence identities, exact quotations and native page/time loci. Never invent missing originals, authority, dates, transcripts or positions. Treat question premises and causal inferences as hypotheses. If validation_errors and previous_draft are supplied, return a complete corrected answer supported by the same evidence; preserve uncertainty instead of manufacturing support. When inquiry_type is not institutional, also consider the supplied thinker/field question; never attribute a field claim to the thinker.
